name: PTK 9752TG-D Digital Servo (Titanium Gear, Coreless)
notes:
Recommended for 1/10 and up through 1/8 — short course trucks (Slash), 1/8 buggies (Arrma Typhon), Traxxas Jato 4x4. Low-profile, coreless motor, titanium gear train. 15-25kg·cm torque depending on voltage (2S LiPo ready, 4.8-7.4V), 0.10s/60° speed, 60g, 2μs dead band.

⚠️ Digital servo — set your receiver/ESC to 333Hz, not analog/50Hz. Running any digital servo in analog mode will burn it out.
⚠️ Requires a minimum 8A BEC. Undersized BECs will brown out.
